description: C40.11 shared selfie capture constants, read by TypeScript (contracts, the web flow, checks), Python (the head-turn clip generator) and Kotlin (the Android SDK), each with a test that it uses this file. The server pose thresholds are provisional: a principled anchor measured on re-posed public-domain faces (measurement below), never fitted to the clip. Change them only with a new measurement; if the clip cannot meet them, the generator changes, never the thresholds.

measurement.method: Each public-domain face of fixtures/manifest.json, as a 640-pixel frame, re-posed with MediaPipe's canonical face mesh (services/vision/tools/repose.py) at each yaw below; YuNet (face_detection_yunet_2026may) re-detects the largest face and its yaw ratio is read (C41.1). min-side-yaw-ratio-change is the median change from the face's own 0-degree ratio at +-12 degrees; max-center-yaw-ratio is the median absolute ratio at +-5 degrees; the clip's target yaw is the smallest from 22 to 25 degrees whose smallest change clears 1.25 x the minimum change.
measurement.caveat: Rendered 2.5-D turns of three studio portraits: pipeline fixtures, not real head turns, so these numbers anchor provisional defaults and calibrate nothing.
